content.title: Planting Calendar
content.body:
This note serves as a seasonal reference for planting dates and tasks for each vegetable in the Backyard Vegetable Garden.

## Plan Details
- **Content**: Develop a detailed planting calendar to track planting dates and seasonal tasks for each vegetable.
- **Goal**: Create a reference schedule for planting and maintaining vegetables throughout the season.
- **Deadline**: 2023-04-01
- **Notes**: Ensure the calendar aligns with zone 7b planting seasons and specific vegetable needs for optimal growth.

## Calendar Format
*(To be developed into a tabular format for easy reference once specific vegetables and dates are finalized.)*
